note: In Routt NF's North Park / Mount Zirkel area on 50-acre Teal Lake (electric and non-motorized boats only), ~9,000 ft; many sites lost their shade to beetle kill. GPS and map apps misroute here: follow the Forest Service directions (Hwy 14 to Hebron, CR 24 west to FR 60, then FR 615 ~3 mi); the Buffalo Pass road is rough and needs 4WD. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov group-site listing (232425, which carries all 17 sites) + catalog + FS drinking-water notice: confirmed 17 sites, vault toilets, water (hand pump), $20, sites 3 and 9 reservable; max_rig_ft 25 (from reviews) -> 30 (recreation.gov permitted equipment); added booking (7-day cutoff, reservation season June 1 - Sept 15), season early June - Oct. Note cleaned (field facts and the review length dropped). Lakeview kept.
flags: Phone: none stored. Parks Ranger District, Walden, (970) 723-2700 (recreation.gov facility phone for Teal Lake; the FS drinking-water notice gives the same number). Suggest 970-723-2700.
Website: add recreation.gov https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/232425 (listed as 'Teal Lake Group Campsite' but holding all 17 sites, 3 and 9 reservable).

Booking conflict: the FS page says 'All individual sites are first come, first served, except for the group site', while recreation.gov's notice and catalog make sites 3 and 9 reservable. Recorded recreation.gov's (current booking system).

Length: no agency page states 25 ft (the stored 25 came from reviews). recreation.gov's catalog permits RVs and trailers up to 30 ft at sites 1-16 (Max Vehicle Length blank). Recorded 30. Over 23 ft, no criteria problem.

Access: FS 'If traveling to this campground through Buffalo Pass, Buffalo Road conditions are rough and results in a much longer drive and requires 4WD.' That is the alternate approach only; the standard route (CR 24 / FR 60 / FR 615 from Hebron) carries no 4WD, RV or trailer wording. No closure on the Medicine Bow-Routt alerts page. Conditions page (as of 10/20/2026): Parks Ranger District 'All Campgrounds closed for the season' (ordinary season end).

Pin: stored 40.58524,-106.60938 is at the west end where the campground road leaves FR 615; the FS point 40.58508,-106.6071 is in the middle of the loop ~195 m east. The catalog gives coordinates only for the group site (40.58454,-106.60551). Under the ~500 m threshold; could move to the FS point.

Waterfront (stored lakeview, kept): on imagery the campground loop runs along the lake's north shore; the main loop road is ~35 m from the water and most site spurs branch north of it, ~40-60 m back. Between road and shore is an open, beetle-thinned slope with scattered small conifers. The loop road between the sites and the water is a used strip, so lakefront is not earned on the evidence available (no per-site coordinates; a few spurs at the west end may sit closer); the view is open, so lakeview stands.
